data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1663 (MERGED; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).

AC1 — all 23 `_expire_sync_marker` sites enumerated and split by what the sync is FOR: 8 fixture preconditions vs 15 where reconvergence through the production read path IS the property under test.

AC2 — the 8 preconditions now use the checked `_sync_from_origin` (fetch + ff-only merge); their downstream asserts are relabelled SETUP. The other 15 keep the engine read and gained a named home, `_reconverge_by_read_sync`, whose docstring records why converting them would delete the invariant they exist to prove. One site (the scenario-A `show`) both drives and asserts its own sync, documented in place.

AC3 — under REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off the contrast is decisive. Before: 8 failures, several setup-shaped and uninformative (`assert 'shared' in set()`, `B did not observe A's edit`, two bare CalledProcessError). After: 7 failures, every one an on-topic invariant assertion, no SETUP assert fired — i.e. every converted precondition still lands with the best-effort read path disabled. test_scenario_b flipped from failing to passing. Default env: 29 passed, unchanged from baseline.

AC4 — make lint and make typecheck pass; no wall-clock assertions introduced.
